title: Keep a reusable prompt record
summary: A useful prompt record includes the request, purpose, test cases and known limits. This makes later edits easier to compare.
introduction: A useful prompt record includes the request, purpose, test cases and known limits. This makes later edits easier to compare. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain keep a reusable prompt record
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A useful prompt record includes the request, purpose, test cases and known limits. This makes later edits easier to compare.

blocks.code:
Name: club-notice room finder
Purpose: extract a room from supplied text
Rules: use source only; report missing or conflicting details
Checks: clear room, missing room, changed room, conflict
Limit: source itself may be wrong
blocks.title: Keep a reusable prompt record

blocks.text: The record captures the job and evidence used to judge it. The model name and settings can also be noted when comparing a real tool over time.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a record for a beginner word explainer.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A prompt that worked once can fail after input, model or settings change; keep checking it.
For more detail later, use this [Prompt Engineering further reading](https://www.promptingguide.ai/introduction).
